ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and identify potential vulnerabilities in the program.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How can the state's Medicaid program be improved to prevent similar instances of fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a significant problem in Minnesota's Medicaid program and to identify ways to improve the program to prevent similar instances of fraud.
